prompt: The video begins with a first-person perspective of someone walking through a dark, forested area at night under a starry sky. The camera moves steadily forward, revealing silhouettes of tall trees and a distant building partially obscured by the darkness. As the person continues walking, the camera pans slightly to the left, showing more of the surrounding dense forest and the faint outlines of additional structures. The environment is quiet and devoid of any other individuals, with the only light coming from the stars above and occasional faint ambient light filtering through the trees. The camera angle remains mostly level, focusing on the path ahead while occasionally tilting upward to capture the starry expanse. The scene transitions smoothly as the person navigates through the terrain, with the camera capturing the subtle interplay of shadows cast by the trees against the ground. The overall atmosphere is serene yet mysterious, with the cloudy and foggy weather adding an element of depth and obscurity to the nighttime setting. The video concludes with the person continuing their journey deeper into the forest, the camera maintaining its steady pace and capturing the tranquil beauty of the natural surroundings.
